name: Dunja Bernatzky
bio:
Dunja Bernatzky is a European producer and the co-founder and CEO of arx anima, the Vienna-based animation studio she started in 2011, where she also heads IP development. The studio works across animated features, series and visual effects with teams in Vienna, Frankfurt, Leipzig and Madrid.

She produced the animated feature Monster Mia (2026), which she also co-wrote, and is producer on Guardian Rabbits: The Secret of the Golden Egg (2027) and Pirate Mo and the Legend of the Red Ruby. She co-produced Rabbit Academy: Mission Eggpossible (2022) and The Super Elfkins (2024), and was executive producer for arx anima on the first three seasons of the animated series Talking Tom & Friends, which the studio developed and produced together with Outfit7. She also directs the voice recordings on arx anima's own productions.

On projects where arx anima works as a service studio she is credited as executive visual effects producer: the animated features The Elfkins: Baking a Difference (2019) and Raven the Little Rascal: Hunt for the Lost Treasure (2019), the science-fiction feature Rubikon (2022), the fantasy feature A Girl Named Willow (2025), the Sky series Django (2023), the comedy Hades (2023) and the documentaries Matter Out of Place (2022) and Mutzenbacher (2022).
